correctness.rationale: Exact quartic phase integration gives S_jk<=epsilon. Rowwise maximal retention deletes mass R<=binom(d,2)epsilon; columnwise norm bounds and nonzero normalization give a true isometry and explicit operator norm estimate. The explicit two-to-three-dimensional witness has defect 8 delta^4, has distance >= delta from every restricted isometry (including zero columns), and distance <=delta+O(delta^4) from an explicit isometry; hence the exponent and limit follow. The proof treats all complex entries, quantifiers, and epsilon=0; CHECK.py is supplementary.
